newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Tongkah sells stake in Internet unit.
newsitem.headline: Tongkah sells stake in Internet unit.

text.p: Tongkah Holdings Bhd said it has entered into an agreement with newspaper publisher Utusan Melayu (M) Bhd to sell its entire 70 percent stake in an Internet services provider firm to Utusan.
In a statement sent to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange at the weekend Tongkah said it was selling the entire stake of 4.21 million shares in THB Asia Connect Sdn Bhd for 20 million ringgit in cash.

At midday on Monday, Tongkah's stock was up two cents to 4.62 ringgit, while Utusan shares gained five cents to 2.90 ringgit. Utusan publishes a leading Malay language newspaper in Malaysia as well as magazines and books.

Asia Connect provides a variety of Internet services including web design and marketing. Tongkah said the sale would allow it to "refocus its involvement in niche areas in the information technology sector". It did not elaborate.
In December 1995, diversified Tongkah said it was acquiring the 70 percent stake in Asia Connect for 15.75 million ringgit in cash.
The proposed sale will not have any material financial impact on Tongkah's earnings and net tangible assets for the financial year ending June 30, 1997, it said.
